name: How often should I schedule restoration maintenance for my property in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How often should I schedule restoration maintenance for my property in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of restoration maintenance depends on several factors, including the type of restoration performed, the age of the property, and local environmental conditions. For properties in the Bay Area, exposure to coastal weather and seismic activity can influence wear and tear. Generally, an annual inspection is recommended, with more frequent checks for specific vulnerable areas like roofs, foundations, or exterior finishes. Our team can assess your property and provide a tailored maintenance schedule.
